meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 把解析后的文档和用户意图转成四张卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡。黄卡经监察院复核过度声明，红卡经丞相府补行动建议，每张卡都带来源、可溯源。
howto.when: 当你给出解析后的结构化文档和查询目标，需要产出可审计的四类卡片时接管，由通政司 Worker 主调用；低置信度解析会触发人工复核标记。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档，先生成事实蓝卡
say.note: 对应 extract 阶段，产出蓝卡

say.text: 帮我复核黄卡，检查有没有过度声明
say.note: 对应 review 阶段，产出绿卡与黄卡

say.text: 根据蓝卡和绿卡，给出下一步行动建议
say.note: 对应 propose 阶段，产出红卡

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed document and user intent into four cards: fact (blue), explanation (green), risk (yellow), action (red). Yellow cards get overclaim review, red cards get strategy input, and each card keeps a traceable source.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you supply a parsed structured document plus a query goal and need auditable cards; the TongZhengSi worker is the main caller.

say_en.text: Analyze this document into four-color cards, starting with the fact card.
say_en.note: Runs the extract stage, outputs the blue card.

say_en.text: Review the yellow card and flag any overclaiming.
From the blue and green cards, suggest next actions.
say_en.note: Runs the propose stage, outputs the red card.
